title: Defend our Neighbors: Demonstration at ICE Detention Facility in Graham
description:
Engaged Durhamites for Democracy is planning a demonstration against ICE in front of the Graham Detention Facility on Sat Aug 9, 10am-12pm. The address is: 109 S Maple StGraham, NC 27253

The only ICE detention facility in NC is in Graham. We need to make it clear that we will not stand for ICE kidnapping our neighbors here in NC! Let's shine a spotlight on this facility with a BIG sign saying "Freedom 4 All!" as well as the one we have in Spanish. 

Let's wave American flags and hold up signs for OUR values, with positive messages like liberty, justice, due process, our constitution, protect our neighbors, immigrants build communities, poor and huddled masses yearning to breathe free, and more.

We will meet on the corner of W Elm and S Maple St by the detention center. 

Parking options:
Free public lot behind 201 W Elm St
Parking by 111 W Pine St may be public lot, check for signs

Please NO antagonizing or hateful signs! And of course NO violence, de-escalation ONLY. Of course we are angry but we want to remain righteous and forward-focused.

Please bring donations for the Emergency Council.  They are in need of personal care items (tooth paste, tooth brushes, deodorant, etc.) as well as dog and cat food!  

Thank you!!

title: Broken Trust Week - Senator Daines Swore an Oath, We're Holding Him To It
description:
Steve Daines is failing Montana. He’s not doing his job, and we can’t trust him. Join Indivisible Bozeman for a series of rallies during the first week of the August congressional recess to shine a light on the BAD decisions Senator Steve Daines is making on behalf of Montanans. 

We're going to start the recess off right - with a rally at 8:30 am on Monday, August 4. Who needs coffee when you've got a rally of fired-up constituents to jumpstart your work week?

On Monday, we tell Senator Daines that we don't trust him to protect our safety and our Constitution. Our friends and neighbors are being kidnapped and detained without due process. Meanwhile, Daines sits silently by as masked and unidentified secret police do as they please. Can the Senator guarantee that he will protect our constitutional right to due process and ensure that Montanans aren't illegally kidnapped off the streets of our community?

📢 Where: Public sidewalks at W. Oak St. & Twin Lakes Ave.

🗣️ What to Expect: We’ll rally on the public sidewalks with speakers and signs and take turns entering the office in pairs to deliver our messages directly to Senator Daines’ staff.

✍️ How to Prepare: Bring your comments and signs — or just come to stand in solidarity.

Whether you’re ready to speak or simply want to show support, your presence matters. Let’s keep up the pressure!

*Note - if you do not intend to go in the office to meet with the Senator's staff, please park on the public streets instead of in the building's parking lot.

title: Forum on Racial & Economic Justice
description:
Join Minnesota AFL-CIO Racial & Economic Justice Committee members, and local and state Labor Leaders to discuss how the Labor Movement can grow and support each other in Racial and Economic Justice personal and shared work. We will come together to learn from each other through panel discussions, small group collaboration and personal feedback to grow.

The Forum will begin with panel discussions.  Panelists will share their Racial and Economic justice journeys, programs, and/or how involvement in the labor movement has helped them and their communities.  We will then participate in a module from the AFL-CIO Racial and Solidarity Trainings and finally conclude the evening with sharing and personal reflection time. 

This event is open to all Labor leaders and activists who share a good faith desire to eliminate racism in our movement and our state and make sure the labor movement is welcoming and inclusive to all.

Program is from 5:00-7:30 with dinner starting at 4:45.

title: Money Out of Politics - Volunteer Recruitment Party
description:
Come hang out with us while we recruit volunteers and assemble volunteer packets. There will be food, music, and the chance to get to know other volunteers with Michigan United Action.  It's okay if you're new to this campaign, we'll teach you all about it!


Michigan United Action is part of **Michiganders for Money Out of Politics (MMOP)**. We are going to fight back against corporate control of our government.

**Our goal:** Pass a citizen-led ballot initiative that bans political contributions from regulated monopoly utilities (like DTE and Consumers Energy) and corporations that seek or hold large state and local government contracts (over $250,000)

**Why?** Simple: We want to stop corporations from buying off our democracy.

**Is this a campaign you support?** Just ask yourself: Do we want a government that serves us — or a government bought and paid for by corporations?

Decorate your car/truck and join us as we drive around Tulsa on a predetermined route. Examples of signs include “Crush ICE”, “No King”, “Return NPR”, “Save Education” or “Retain Medicare”.
Bring water/snacks and good vibes. 
Make sure you’ve filled up your gas tank because this motor march will take 90-120 minutes.

We’ll meet and finish at : Mohawk Park
6700 Mohawk Blvd / Shelter 6
August 16th
Rain date: August 23

Gather   9-10am. 
10am     Resistance Caravan takes off!
12pm.    Event finishes at Mohawk Park

Route will be given to participants when they arrive at the park. 
We’re borrowing this idea from Indivisible Tucson!
Their car decoration tips can be found at https://drivefordemocracy.com/participate/
Please follow all Safety Guidelines.

Share on Social Media with #Resistancecaravan.
